title: Setup of the non-forward simulator
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans and let $x$ be a Boolean word. There is a time $t\le 5(|x|+1)$ such that, if decoding $x$ yields $(a,b)$, the non-forward simulator reaches the virtual configuration for $M$ initialized on $b$, with tag true, input position $|x|+1$, buffer $a$, and output the encoding of $(a,[])$. If decoding $x$ is undefined, the simulator at time $t$ is halted with empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
